payload.name: Capture preference from make-money-doing-what-I-love statements
payload.description: Use when a message says someone makes money doing what they love or expresses passion/enjoyment for an activity, during extraction of memory candidates.
content: During extraction, when a speaker says they make money doing what they love or expresses passion/enjoyment about an activity, include a preference memory (or add to the candidate content) recording that they love/enjoy that activity, not only the event or financial outcome.
If the activity is already named in the same message, tie the preference to that exact activity; when updating an existing memory, preserve this affective detail.

solves: Extraction candidates can keep an event and financial gain while dropping the speaker's explicit statement that the activity is loved, leaving later preference questions unsupported. This skill applies to any message with love/passion/enjoyment language tied to an activity, instructing extraction to record the preference alongside the event so future questions about liked or profitable activities are answerable.
